# Kelley Blue Book Lease Deals

Retrieve the current '10 Best Lease Deals Around $200' editorial list from Kelley Blue Book in one round trip. Each deal carries the vehicle name as one string (e.g.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/kbb/lease-deals" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

This API runs asynchronously. The call returns a task `id` with status `pending`; poll `GET https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/run/{id}` until `status` is `completed` and read the result from `outputs[0].data`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `zip_code` | string | No | 5-digit US ZIP code. Accepted and echoed back; deals are national listings and do not vary by location. |

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls are not charged.
